title: 777 Partners' Founder Pleads Guilty, Southwest Blows Up Rapid Rewards, and a Flight to Nowhere
summary: The man behind the collapse of two budget airlines admits to a $500 million fraud scheme — and it's wilder than you'd think. Plus, Southwest overhauls its entire loyalty program and makes the Companion Pass harder to get, a Singapore Airlines flight spends nine hours going absolutely nowhere, and Lufthansa finally reveals where its brand-new A350-1000 is headed first.
